content.title: About
content.content: Oven roasted turkey lunchmeat is a ready‑to‑eat product made from tender turkey breast that has been slowly baked in the oven. The slices are vacuum‑packed, shelf‑stable until opened, and perfect for sandwiches, salads, and quick snacks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey meat is lower in fat than most red meats.
Traditional preparation involves low‑heat oven roasting, preserving flavor and nutrients.
Lunchmeat slices are vacuum‑sealed, extending shelf life without added preservatives.
Turkey is a good source of selenium, a mineral that supports immune function.
The product is popular in low‑calorie diets because of its lean profile.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: A typical serving provides about 20 g of high‑quality protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with many meat delicacies, turkey contains very little saturated fat.

items.title: Source of vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 aids amino‑acid metabolism and supports nervous‑system health.

items.title: Contains zinc
items.content: Zinc is essential for immune function and wound healing.

items.title: Low‑calorie option
items.content: One slice contains roughly 70 kcal, making it suitable for weight‑management plans.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to bird meat.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: To enhance flavor, the product may contain added salt; those monitoring sodium intake should be aware.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Slices are ideal in sandwiches, wraps, salads, pasta dishes, and omelets. They can be eaten cold or gently warmed in a pan or microwave, though heating is optional.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C. After opening, transfer to an airtight container and use within a few days. If frozen, the product can be kept for up to 2 months.
